name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: ECMWF Snow forecast with wet-bulb-zero snowline contours, terrain comparison, precipitation, modelled snow depth when supplied by Windy point data, and a simple snow / near-snowline / rain phase timeline. Version 5.0.1 uses a ±50 m near-snowline band and improves detailed PNG export and mobile save/share.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
